policy: A flag is a fact about the retrieved evidence, not a guess. Every flag below names the page that was read. Nothing here is published as a product fact on the item tables; items with a missing value keep that value blank.

flags.title: Target-product specifications do not establish explicit solid gold
flags.detail: For all 16 original-register targets, fetched target descriptions/specifications did not establish explicit solid-gold construction. A related product or general page can mention solid gold without proving this exact ring. This absence is not proof the item is plated.
flags.recommended_action: Ask each seller in writing to confirm 'solid gold, not plated or filled' and keep the reply with the order record.

flags.title: No listing states a hallmark or maker's mark
flags.detail: The checklist asks for a 10K/14K/18K stamp PLUS a maker's/manufacturer's mark. None of the 16 product pages states what is stamped inside the band, and none names a manufacturer's mark. Blue Nile and VRAI do publish stock/style numbers, which is not the same thing as a physical hallmark.
flags.recommended_action: On arrival, photograph the inside of the band and have an independent jeweller read the stamp and maker's mark under magnification.

flags.title: Metal weight in grams is not published for 15 of 16 items
flags.detail: Only VRAI publishes a metal weight (2.86 g at size 6 for the Classic 4-prong). For the other 15 listings the gram weight field is left blank rather than estimated. Without a weight, a price-per-gram or melt comparison cannot be computed for those items.
flags.recommended_action: Request the gram weight from the seller before paying, then verify on a jeweller's scale after delivery.

flags.title: Zales V-19957449: cached snippet $719.20 vs live page $899.00
flags.detail: A search-engine snippet for this product showed 'Discounted Price $719.20, Original Price $899.00, 20% Off'. The live product page retrieved on 2026-10-22 shows 'Discounted Price $899.00' with no original price and no discount. The live value is recorded; the snippet value is rejected and kept only as an audit note.
flags.recommended_action: Re-check the price in the cart at checkout; do not budget from any cached figure.

flags.title: Blue Nile 193625: snippet $1,845 vs live page $1,950
flags.detail: A search-engine snippet for the Petite Three-Stone in 14k yellow gold showed $1,845. The live page on 2026-10-22 showed $1,950 (Setting Price). Live value recorded.
flags.recommended_action: Treat all Blue Nile prices as live-only; re-check before ordering.

flags.title: Blue Nile 315661: snippet showed -25% ($1,657) but live page shows $2,210
flags.detail: The cached snippet advertised a 25% reduction to $1,657. The live page showed $2,210 (Setting Price) with no discount banner in the retrieved text. The higher, live figure is recorded. A promotional price may still exist in-cart; it was not verifiable at retrieval.
flags.recommended_action: If a promo is claimed, capture the cart screen with the discount line before paying.

flags.title: Brilliant Earth price was served in EUR, not USD
flags.detail: The Brilliant Earth page rendered '€ 990.00 (Setting Only)' at retrieval, and the site's currency selector showed EUR active. The USD price was never displayed, so it is not recorded and no exchange-rate conversion was invented. The item is marked with currency EUR.
flags.recommended_action: Switch the site region to United States to read the USD price before comparing with the other rows.

flags.title: VRAI price is rendered client-side and was absent from the retrieved HTML
flags.detail: The VRAI configurator page supplied full specs (18k yellow gold, 2.86 g metal weight, 1.6 mm band depth, 30-day returns) but no price string was present in the retrieved text. The price field is deliberately blank. A search snippet claimed 'Starting at $1,035' - that figure is rejected and shown only as an audit note.
flags.recommended_action: Read the price in the VRAI configurator directly, or request a written quote.

flags.title: James Allen product URLs now redirect to Blue Nile and some items are sold out
flags.detail: jamesallen.com/.../comfort-fit-engagement-ring-item-41515 (listed at $660 in a cached snippet) redirected to bluenile.com and rendered 'This popular style is sold out'. James Allen settings are now sold inside the Blue Nile catalogue, so brand and seller are no longer the same entity. Item 41515 is excluded from the tables.
flags.recommended_action: Buy James Allen designs through the Blue Nile listing and note that the warranty/contact entity is Blue Nile.

flags.title: Blue Nile returns exclude items resized after purchase and custom orders
flags.detail: Blue Nile's official return page states a 30-day window from shipment and explicitly excludes 'items resized after initial purchase', custom orders, engraved items and personalised jewellery. Since the checklist requires inspecting and verifying before resizing, resize AFTER the independent test and only once the ring is confirmed.
flags.recommended_action: Order the ring in your size; do not accept a resize before XRF testing.

flags.title: Zales return policy is only evidenced by a product-page claim
flags.detail: Every Zales product page retrieved states 'Free and easy 30-day returns', but the standalone return-policy page URL was not captured, so exclusions (resized, custom, clearance) are unknown and left blank.
flags.recommended_action: Open the Zales return policy and confirm the resize/custom exclusions before ordering.

flags.title: General card networks and issuer protection terms remain unconfirmed
flags.detail: Blue Nile product pages display financing offers with the Blue Nile Credit Card. This does not establish all accepted card networks, exact checkout eligibility or guaranteed dispute protection. Other network/payment details remain unconfirmed; do not mistake an absence of captured network data for absence of a card offer.
flags.recommended_action: Confirm card acceptance at checkout and keep the card-issuer dispute window in mind.

flags.title: LBMA fix prices are behind an IBA licence; a different official quote was used
flags.detail: lbma.org.uk states that tabulated LBMA Precious Metal Prices have moved to the MyLBMA portal and require an IBA licence. No free LBMA fix value could be retrieved. The calculator therefore uses the World Gold Council gold spot page (market data by ICE Data Services) with an explicit quote date.
flags.recommended_action: For contract-grade valuations, obtain LBMA data under licence or use your jeweller's own assay price.

flags.title: Costco items were excluded because price and gram weight did not render
flags.detail: Two Costco 14kt diamond ring pages were retrieved. The product page returned full specifications, shipping and returns text but no price and no gram weight (both are client-side). A cached snippet showed a $3,999.99 price for a different solitaire, which cannot be tied to a retrieved page. Costco is therefore listed as a candidate retailer but contributes no rows.
flags.recommended_action: If Costco is wanted, capture the price while signed in and ask the jewellery desk for the gram weight.

flags.title: Setting-only prices and complete-ring prices sit in the same tables
flags.detail: 10 Blue Nile rows plus Brilliant Earth and VRAI are setting-only configurations; the center diamond is selected separately. Zales pages describe diamond rings but fetched excerpts do not establish selected size/currency/checkout scope. Preserve those distinctions and obtain the exact full-ring quote; no missing currency is inferred.
flags.recommended_action: Compare setting prices with setting prices only; add a centre-stone quote before comparing with a complete ring.

flags.title: Dollar-sign displays lack confirmed ISO currency/configuration
flags.detail: The prior USD normalization was not established by the fetched official product bodies. Numeric normalized price and currency fields are now null. The original displayed string and prior normalization are retained only as historical research observations, not current verified prices. VRAI also lacks a captured main-product price.
flags.recommended_action: Confirm native currency and the exact selected size/configuration at checkout. Do not infer USD from a dollar sign or a country-domain assumption.

flags.title: WGC moving-header quote timestamp is unconfirmed
flags.detail: The earlier recorded 4,028.53 USD/oz header observation was assigned a 22 October quote date even though chart metadata read Data as of 21 October, 2026. A fresh retrieval displayed a different moving header. The chart date does not establish the header timestamp; quote_date is left null, separate from the retained retrieval date. The expanded calculator uses a separately dated dealer body/table reference.
flags.recommended_action: Keep quote-as-of time blank until directly bound to the actual quote; never refresh the observation timestamp merely by rebuilding.
